items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: I've contacted my personal friend over there, Paul Barbaran.

ctx.x: And the band stopped up there after they needed to get their check cash, and they came up to see if somebody else could cash it across the street. Larry Bornstein didn't. And I happened to have the cash there. Yeah. Yeah. I cashed the check for them, and I got paid them that night. But Peter looks quite well. He's gray-haired and thinner than he used to be, but he plays very well. And he made some records about in February, Mardi Gras time, with his own little dance band, and it sounded very good.
I think some of the old regs. Well, I intend going back to New Orleans in July on a short visit, and I've contacted my personal friend over there, Paul Barbaran. Oh, yes.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: Yeah, well you've got Pops Foster and Paul Ballgren, Monty Johnson and Eddie Conda and Louie Russell.

ctx.x: Yeah, well you've got Pops Foster and Paul Ballgren, Monty Johnson and Eddie Conda and Louie Russell.
Oh, they're just playing. That's all you know. Yeah. That's another one of these great big tones that we call a balloon tone.
